title: Start a Chapter
description: Start a Bay Area Youth Conservation chapter at your school, club, library, or community space.

header.heading: Bring youth conservation education to your community.
header.body: Interested in starting a Bay Area Youth Conservation chapter? Share a few details with us, and we will follow up with next steps.

intro.heading: Tell us what you want to build.
intro.body: Chapters can help students organize workshops, volunteer projects, education posts, and local conservation activities in their own school or community space.

details.heading: Students and youth leaders
details.body: If you want to bring conservation education to your school, club, library, or neighborhood group, this is the place to start.

details.heading: A short interest form
details.body: The form asks for your contact information, community or school name, and what kind of chapter support you are looking for.

details.heading: Handbook coming soon
details.body: A chapter handbook with more guidance will be added once it is ready.

formCta.heading: Ready to start?
formCta.body: Use the Google Form to tell us you are interested in starting a chapter. We will add handbook details here once they are available.
